payload.title: Qualify protected-validation evidence input closure and exact-state reuse
payload.summary: Priority1 bounded operational-reliability investigation. scripts/backlog/integration/local.py computes review_subject from result/base/files and may reuse a previous passed protected_validation on an equal subject. Existing task/baseline/Checkout protections also apply. Determine the actual protected-run input closure (source, relevant tests/read dependencies, plan, config, runner and supported toolchain/environment), then qualify unchanged-state reuse and changed-input rejection. This is not a claim of a historical bypass and not authorization to redesign validation.
payload.benefit: Acceptance: enumerate/authenticate exact relevant input closure and documented exclusions; demonstrate passing unchanged-tree evidence reused once; change source, test, plan, config, runner and relevant toolchain inputs independently and prove stale evidence rejected or checks renewed. Preserve100% production coverage, original records, source restoration, review binding and authority. Report unmeasured inputs honestly. Later bounded implementation only after investigation and authorization.
payload.uncertainty: Current subject may be sufficient under other task/baseline constraints; no invalid publication is demonstrated. Toolchain/environment relevance, representation normalization, external-effect evidence and durable-schema compatibility need qualification. Prefer existing evidence identities/consumers; no generic validator, success cache or Trace framework. Suitable for a maintenance agent only with a frozen mutation matrix and independent review.
